title: The smallest useful inference
hypothesis: A minimal float32 Add graph can load and evaluate through the legacy WinRT CPU API in an x64 Xbox UWP app.

environment.hardware: Xbox Series S / Series X — not yet executed

reproduction: Create the UWP blank app described in tutorial 04.
Generate add.onnx using examples/generate_model.py and record its SHA-256.
Add the model as Content; adapt examples/Probe.cs to the blank app.
Deploy Release x64 to the console; run without the debugger.
Export raw timing, environment and correctness logs with commit and artifact checksums.
limitations: No physical console execution evidence is available.
Linux model checks cannot establish Windows or Xbox API compatibility.
GPU execution is outside this experiment.
